distribution_paid_declared.verbatim_line: Not disclosed as a distinct for-year total in the audited Distribution Statement (p159); statement discloses only distributions PAID during the year (76,714) plus DPU declared 9.600 cents. For-year declared distribution S$78,154k appears only in Financial Review / Financial Highlights (commentary, p16) - excluded per audited-only rule.

rollforward.notes: Audited Distribution Statement, YEAR ENDED 31 March 2025, Group column (p159). A(opening 19,234) + B(for-year 78,159) - P(paid 76,714) = 20,679 = E(closing), exact match, guard passes. B is DERIVED and FLAGGED: the audited statement discloses cumulative 'Amount available for distribution to Unitholders' = 97,393 (the trap line, which folds in the 19,234 opening carry); the true for-year income generated before retention = 97,393 - 19,234 = 78,159 (= taxable 65,669 + tax-exempt 1,435 + capital 11,055). 78,159 does not appear verbatim anywhere (searched); matches existing performance.json net_distributable_income (78,159,000), confirmed. P (76,714) is cash paid during FY (period-mixed: Q4 FY2024 tranche through Q3 FY2025); the Q4 FY2025 tranche is paid post-FYE and is not in the in-year paid list. All values in full SGD (statement is $'000, x1000 to match extraction convention).

txns.gain_basis: Disclosed premium of 32.5% above valuation, but ONLY in AR narrative (Chairman & CEO Statement p16 'a price 32.5% above valuation'; Board/strategy section p17 'at a 32.5% premium') - NOT in the audited portfolio statement or FS notes. Audited FS (Portfolio Statement footnote 4 p162; Note 4 p191) state 3 Toh Tuck Link at fair value = agreed sale price S$24.388m; carrying value = sale price, so vs_book_value gain = 0% and no gain is recognised (completion post-FYE). No independent valuation is disclosed in the audited statements to derive against; the 32.5% premium implies a pre-reclassification valuation of ~S$18.4m. FLAGGED: premium is commentary-sourced, not audited-statement-derived.
txns.verbatim: Footnote 4 (Portfolio Statement p162 / Note 4 p191): 'On 10 December 2024, the Group announced the proposed divestment of the leasehold property at 3 Toh Tuck Link in Singapore, at a sale price of S$24.388 million. The investment property, including the corresponding right-of-use assets, was reclassified to investment property held for sale and the corresponding lease liabilities was reclassified to liabilities directly associated with the investment property held for sale as at 31 March 2025. The divestment ... is targeted to be completed [after year-end].' Note 4 (p191): 'Fair value of investment property held for sale (based on agreed sale price) 24,388; Add: carrying amount of lease liabilities 618; Investment property held for sale 25,006' ($'000). Statement of Total Return FY2025 'Gain on divestment of investment property' = nil (the 637 gain relates to FY2024's 541 Yishun). announcement_gap=true: after-FYE completion, gain not recognised, net sale proceeds not disclosed in AR - MAIN to top up from SGX announcement.
